Overview.Name: Vishwa Shanthi
Overview.Food_Habit: I can eat one bite and stop
Overview.Goal: Feeling energetic & confident, Preventing/reversing health issues, Mental wellbeing & stress reduction
Overview.Preference_Notes: Balanced – include non-veg but not in every meal, avoids non-veg on Monday, Tuesday, Saturday

Meal_1: Option 1: Egg omelette (2–3 eggs) + small bowl curd
Option 2: Paneer cubes (120 g) pan fried + cucumber slices
Option 3: RICE RAWA upma (~150 g) + curd
Meal_2 (Main Meal): Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & chicken curry (120 g) & vegetable curry + curd
Option 2: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & fish curry (120 g) & vegetable curry
Option 3: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & paneer curry (120 g) & vegetable curry
Meal_4 (Dinner - light): Option 2: Cooked rice (1 cup ~150 g) & egg omelette (2–3 eggs)
Option 3: Cooked rice (1 cup ~150 g) & paneer cubes (120 g) + vegetable curry

Notes_and_Tips: Start every meal with protein to control blood sugar and hormones.
Follow vegetarian meals on Monday, Tuesday and Saturday.
Avoid fried, sugary and processed foods completely.
Keep meals at consistent timings to support thyroid and PCOS balance.
Late-night eating should be avoided to improve recovery and fat loss.
Choose soft, simple foods and avoid excess strain to support knee health.
